cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Interpret the Custom
cards.instruction: Ask them to apply an ambiguous custom where the wording is unclear. Treat their interpretation as the real test of loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I leave for my shift, tell me what you're saving me. Our family says 'a proper portion'; I'll hear your interpretation before you serve seconds.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It doesn't say how big. Would a corner do?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Show me the corner. I'll decide whether that looks like someone we're expecting home, rather than someone we're clearing up after.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your brothers are asking for seconds. They want that corner too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then set my plate beside theirs before you answer. You choose what 'proper' means for me; I want to see whether arriving later has made me less your family.

reason: Let A control when service proceeds and judge B interpretation as loyalty, using B4 competition for the exact proposed corner to demand visible equal-family treatment.
